description:
Advances: ancora.derive

Stage: L6 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Git (all git subprocess use; the only spawner in the codebase), Ancora.Git.BatchPort (one git cat-file --batch port per run, owned by the run context, never registered; spawned without stderr_to_stdout), Ancora.BaseView (port), Ancora.Derive.ChangeSet (git diff --name-status --no-renames <base> union git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all; serial base-blob prefetch before any parallelism; per-file git show escape hatch behind the same function head). Per-run ETS memo table passed by reference in the run context; memo prefers DefIndex/resolver results over raw ASTs. NOTICE entries.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.derive.change_set_union, base_reads_batched, memo_is_run_scoped; ancora.gate.only_git_is_spawned lands its static test here too (spawner test over lib/)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.derive.scenario.new_dir_new_test_is_growth (change-set half), moved_module_is_delete_plus_add, batch_port_frames, two_concurrent_runs_do_not_collide; ancora.gate.scenario.forbidden_spawner_test
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: ChangeSet and BatchPort are consumed by Ancora.Derive (L7b/L8) and Gate (L9); proving tests here are the runtime git-init tmp repo cases
  - Fixture hygiene: git repos created at runtime in tmp dirs (never committed fixtures); no named ETS, no registered ports; tests async
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (untracked dir, D+A move, escape hatch path)
- Call-site Integration: consumed by the detector pipeline (L7/L8) and Gate (L9). Proving tests now: BatchPort frame parser against captured byte streams; runtime git init tmp repos; a test pinning that git stderr cannot interleave into stdout.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/derive/{module_locator,membership,def_index,resolver,extract,compare,ack}.ex (L7/L8)
- lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/output*, lib/mix/tasks/**
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/git.ex, lib/ancora/git/batch_port.ex, lib/ancora/base_view.ex, lib/ancora/derive/change_set.ex, lib/ancora/derive/run_context.ex
- test/ancora/git*_test.exs, test/ancora/base_view_test.exs, test/ancora/derive/change_set_test.exs, test/ancora/static/forbidden_spawner_test.exs, test/support/**
- NOTICE
- .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no on-disk cache; no named tables; no registered ports
- no git rename detection (moves are D+A by design)
- no subprocess outside Ancora.Git

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: L6: Git layer and change set
